description: PartitionViewV1 golden bytes (verbatim) and derived cross-implementation vectors produced by the frozen Go reference.

provenance.golden: types/testdata/partition-view/v1 (copied byte-for-byte into golden/, including its manifest.json)
provenance.derived: generator/gen_rust_vectors_test.go.txt dropped into types/ of that commit as gen_rust_vectors_test.go, run with GEN_RUST_VECTORS_DIR=<dir> go test ./types -run Test_GenRustVectors (deterministic: fixed key 0x11*32, fixed seal time; two runs are byte-identical)

note: Not yet frozen upstream: get_inclusion_proofs.v1 JSON shapes (aggregator-go PR 193) and the F1 fixture corpus. This directory only covers the frozen PartitionViewV1 codec and the shard-tree/UC assembly of bft-go-base.
